LuxePass — Epic 3: Lounge Profiles & Details
Same light design system and app shell as Phases 1 and 3 (Explore section of the member area). UI copy in English.
Profile → photos and quick actions → availability → ratings → edge states.

Story 3.1 · Profile: hero carousel with 6 images, name, address and contact, today's hours highlighted, amenity icons with descriptions, rating and review count, and Call / Directions / Share as persistent quick actions.
Story 3.1 · Share sheet over the blurred profile: messaging and social targets plus a copy link. Directions opens a Google Maps URL for the address; Call dials the lounge number.
Story 3.2 · Weekly calendar by time band, booking restrictions (member tier, advance notice, admission for one) and the last updated timestamp with the 5-minute auto-refresh.
Story 3.2 · Not available today with the next openings and a way back to search, and a holiday closure notice with the affected days marked closed in the calendar.
Story 3.1 · Ratings and reviews when they exist, the empty state for a lounge with no ratings yet, and the loading skeleton of the profile while live availability is fetched.
